support_claim: Commercial notes state that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct treating the registry link as unresolved, while billing uses "Northbridge Analytics Inc." and registry row 2019-0008841 lists "NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS LLC" without any observation linking them as the same legal counterparty.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; name similarity between the billed Inc. name and the registry LLC name is insufficient for identity, and no observation affirmatively separates them as distinct entities. The packet preserves live ambiguity—including an additional Wyoming LLC from a credit check—and explicitly records that the registry link cannot be closed, so UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
